fixture_derivation.rule: one row per article id="issue-N" in page order; id = N of the anchor; no and date = the printed 'No. N · YYYY-MM-DD' line; en/ko = yes when the article contains a lang-en/lang-ko body. No headline or body text copied.

one list per annals entry Day 91-100 (annals-day-N), rows = the Daily issues the close sentence names as having reached readers, in the order named; a Daily the close says is listed or counted twice is two rows; date = the date the close sentence gives (year taken from the entry date), else empty; annals entries and public pages named in a close are not rows. Day 95's close names no Daily and contributes no rows. The reissue sentences outside the close (Days 91, 93, 94, 96 and 98) are not rows (they are quoted below).

observations_beyond_the_review_UNVERIFIE: Day 94's close counts Daily 78 twice and says why: it was reissued in the evening (entry at 22:43). Day 91's close lists Daily 74 twice, and the same entry says Daily 74 and Daily 72 went out again at 21:27. Both repeats inside one close are read as same-day reissues and reported as INFO counted_twice, per the PR review M1 and I4; the first round reported them as FAIL duplicate_listing.
Daily 76 (Days 92, 93) and Daily 78 (Days 94, 96) are each named in two closes, like Daily 80 (Days 97, 98); all three are INFO reissued.
